title: Invertible representatives from lifting finite functors
statement: Let J be a small filtered category and F : J → Cat, and equip the object-set colimit O [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] with any category structure and functors V_j : F(j) → O. Assume every functor from a finite category to O is exactly a composite dj ⋙ V_j. Then an arrow a of O is invertible if and only if it is the image under some V_j of an invertible stage arrow, with equality of the complete arrows including endpoints [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor].

source.place: proof of Lemma Tag 09YL (lemma-colimit-sites), first paragraph: 'The formula C = colim C_i means that Ob(C) = colim Ob(C_i) and Arrows(C) = colim Arrows(C_i). Then source, target, and composition are inherited ... Remark that given any finite diagram in C there exists an i such that this diagram is the image of a diagram in C_i' (stated without proof); filtered colimits of sets: categories.tex Section Tag 04AX

proof.text: For an invertible arrow a, form the finite groupoid on two objects and one morphism between any pair. Map its objects to the endpoints of a and its forward and backward arrows to a and its inverse. Lift this functor using the hypothesis. Its forward arrow maps to an invertible stage arrow, with the correct image because the lifted composite functor equals the given one. Conversely, functors preserve isomorphisms. The Lean proof constructs this groupoid locally on ULift Bool with PUnit Hom spaces, so no unfinished category construction is needed for this step.

lean.statement: theorem filteredColimit_category_iso_clause (J : Type z) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{z, z}) : let O := colimit (F ⋙ Cat.objects) ∀ (_s : Category.{z} O), ∀ (V : ∀ j : J, F.obj j ⥤ O), (∀ (D : Type z) [SmallCategory D] [FinCategory D] (d : D ⥤ O), ∃ (j : J) (dj : D ⥤ F.obj j), dj ⋙ V j = d) → (∀ a : Arrow O, IsIso a.hom ↔ ∃ (j : J) (b : Arrow (F.obj j)), IsIso b.hom ∧ (V j).mapArrow.obj b = a)
